title.zh: 将莱特省Carigara市镇拥有25张床位的Carigara区医院扩建为50张床位的区医院
title.en: An Act Expanding the Carigara District Hospital, With a Twenty-five-bed Capacity, in the Municipality of Carigara, Province of Leyte, Into a Fifty-bed Capacity District Hospital
title.orig: An Act Expanding the Carigara District Hospital, With a Twenty-five-bed Capacity, in the Municipality of Carigara, Province of Leyte, Into a Fifty-bed Capacity District Hospital

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7246_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Carigara District Hospital, with a twenty-five-bed capacity, in the Municipality of Carigara, Province of Leyte, is hereby expanded into a fifty-bed capacity district hospital.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be charged against the lump-sum appropriations authorized for the purpose under the current General Appropriations Act. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the hospital shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
